Meta’s FY2024 Form 10-K reports revenue of $164,501 million for 2024 and $134,902 million for 2023. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]

Amazon’s FY2024 Form 10-K reports net sales of $637,959 million for 2024 and $574,785 million for 2023. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]

These are both full-year GAAP revenue (Meta) and net sales (Amazon) figures for fiscal 2023 and 2024, so the periods are directly comparable on a fiscal-year basis, though they represent different businesses and revenue compositions.

Using these figures:
- Meta revenue growth 2023→2024 ≈ (164,501 / 134,902 − 1) × 100 ≈ 21.94 percentage points. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]
- Amazon net sales growth 2023→2024 ≈ (637,959 / 574,785 − 1) × 100 ≈ 10.99 percentage points. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]

Difference in growth rates:
21.94 − 10.99 ≈ 10.95 percentage points.

Therefore, Meta’s revenue grew faster, by about 10.95 percentage points more than Amazon’s.

ANSWER: Meta, by approximately 10.95 percentage points
